review_method: Direct inspection of every rendered page at readable resolution, alongside complete manuscript and figure review

page_notes.1: Title, name and email render cleanly with no affiliation label. Complete abstract and introduction fit; numerical headline and descriptive scope agree with results.
page_notes.2: Condition equation, channel target, geometry counts and graph arithmetic legible. Geometry figure and caption agree; axes, color scale and ganging labels readable; no clipping.
page_notes.3: Canonical versus pilot populations and matched-bank limitations clear. Full architecture diagram and its caption fit together; stage labels, color key and generation-order arrows readable.
page_notes.4: Response mixture, cap, activity mask, target transform and flow loss equations fit within margins. Symbols, numerical floors and accompanying explanations are legible and mutually consistent.
page_notes.5: Masked solver, layer budget, graph-message and top-k equations readable. Count/support subsection transition clean; generation order and connectivity limitation explicit.
page_notes.6: Channel-share target, decoder and nine-term loss fit. Teacher forcing, calibration provenance, staged encoder handling and checkpoint selection are connected in prose; no overprint.
page_notes.7: Evaluation protocol, gap identity, run-count counterexample, denominators, bootstrap and C2ST caveats are complete and legible. Clear separation before results page.
page_notes.8: Aggregate table has aligned numeric columns and complete population caption. Response text and longitudinal figure agree; linear/log panels, legend and axis labels readable.
page_notes.9: Empty-response statistics and longitudinal result explain the figure. Four support panels and annotations agree with table; caption states separate nonempty populations and missing intervals; connectivity discussion fits.
page_notes.10: Classifier screening failure and numerical tolerance distinction explicitly visible. Discussion separates observed gaps, graph confounding, causal hypotheses and robustness limitations. Clean subsection hierarchy.
page_notes.11: Timing boundary, conclusion and data-availability statement agree with study scope. Academia Sinica mentorship acknowledgment retained. Author contributions and AI disclosure fit cleanly.
page_notes.12: Appendix A hashes fit unbroken; calibration table readable and caption explicitly says proposal. Runtime, split and historical test-use limitations preserved; no clipping.
page_notes.13: All eight energy bins and three classifier seeds fit in aligned tables. Captions define intervals, denominators and seed roles. Evaluator settings and paired-split limitation legible.
page_notes.14: All 18 cited references render with readable identifiers, DOI/arXiv links and intact wrapping. No unresolved citations, overlaps or clipped text. Page numbering completes 1-14.
